The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e75bfb353c2d3374), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 103. statement: Fix L, R, R′ and choose H sufficiently large as in Proposition 12.3. Consider two admitted ordinary trajectories of depths N ≥ K ≥ 1, with offsets bounded by R′, common reference scales and caps, and the same precise terminal coupling b0. Align their last K layers on common compatible periods. Write their scalar- stripped endpoint densities as eXi Ξi. On each common admitted terminal torus of volume v, their common refined activity lists satisfy ∥X1 − X2∥∞ ≤ CHvϵK, sup x X λ:x∈Pλ eAsλ ∥k1,λ − k2,λ∥∞ ≤ CHϵK, ϵK = L−(2−υ)K . (13.3) Here Pλ and sλ are the complete support and load of a covering label, and A is the support exponent of the endpoint class. If the common torus is an axis torus satisfying Lemma 13.2 and CHvϵK is sufficiently small, its scalar-stripped partition functions satisfy | log b Z1 − log b Z2| ≤ CHvϵK. (13.4) The constants are independent of N, K, the periods, and the common terminal value.
